Question: What is the average policy size which is the the total amount of premium divided by the number of policies?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS decimal(18,2)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier), 0) AS Average_Policy_Size
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE pa.Policy_Amount IS NOT NULL
  AND pa.Policy_Identifier IS NOT NULL;

What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    p.Policy_Holder,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Payment_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Reserve_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Payment_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Reserve_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p
    ON c.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cr.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp2
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp2.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON cp2.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr2
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cr2.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON cr2.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    p.Policy_Holder,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid;

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?
What is the total amount of premiums that a policy holder has paid by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE pa.Amount_Type_Code = 'PREM'
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    a.Agent_Name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p
    ON c.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Holder ph
    ON p.Policy_Holder_Identifier = ph.Policy_Holder_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agent a
    ON p.Agent_Identifier = a.Agent_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cr.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    a.Agent_Name;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding expense reserve amount by agent id, policy number and claim number
Generated Query:
SELECT
    a.Agent_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Expense_Reserve er
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = (
        SELECT TOP 1 pcd.Policy_Identifier
        FROM Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        WHERE pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    )
JOIN Agreement_Agent aa
    ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agent a
    ON a.Agent_Identifier = aa.Agent_Identifier
GROUP BY
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;
